description: Candidate A - the deterministic baseline evaluator (numeric exact-match + lexical word-overlap only, no LLM call). Represents 'what Phase-6's existing structural checks could already tell us' extended with a naive numeric/lexical layer.
limitation_demonstrated: Cannot detect paraphrase, overclaiming/qualification loss, or non-numeric contradiction - only catches cases with a clean numeric mismatch or near-total lexical overlap. Confirms the exact gap documented in docs/v2/PHASE7_INITIAL_GROUNDING_AUDIT.md.
